entities.summary: Piešťany is a town in Slovakia. It is located in the western part of the country within the Trnava Region and is the seat of its own district. It is the biggest and best known spa town in Slovakia and has around 28,000 inhabitants. Piešťany is a town in Eastern Europe, established around 1113. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 57 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
